For use with all kinds of jigsaws and for any application in wood materials. Features five slots to store the blades firmly and safely whilst allowing for fast and easy access. Consisting of a range of blades specifically for the widest range of applications in wood and one sample blade manufactured with carbide technology. Compact design allows for convenient toolbox storage, providing an organised overview, easy access and safe transport.
